global_constraints: Preserve other model processes and D-drive LLM storage
No replacement of selected production voice or 16-step parameters during comparison
No microphone, physical playback, movement or private database use in unattended tests
Keep cancellation ownership, original request deadlines and bounded queues
Separate cached, uncached, warm and cold results
Use monotonic intervals within each node; do not subtract unsynchronized host wall clocks

experiments.inputs: Fixed public short, medium and long reply texts; exact selected voice and seed; uncached synthesis
metrics: GPU total free and project peak
acceptance: No content loss, extra filler answer or changed quality settings
No mid-answer supply underflow in the fixed corpus; model-dependent sentence pauses reported separately
All added buffering and queue delay included in first-PCM measurements
Reject a memory-only win if end-to-end tail latency or cancellation regresses
stop_if: private or active production requests would be interrupted
unexpected source or device state change

components: existing evidence-only speaker and face association
experiments.inputs: Public or separately authorized speech with true ends, hesitation, internal silence, names and numbers; synthetic identity events with multiple people and camera epoch changes
experiments.mode: shadow only until evaluated; no formal wake/listen/identity decision changed
acceptance: Lower endpoint latency without a worse premature-cut rate on the same labeled corpus
No increase in existing 20ms audio frontend deadline misses
Zero personal-memory unlocks from unconfirmed or conflicting identity evidence
Camera absence does not prevent voice conversation
Model file size not presented as process RAM measurement
stop_if: private enrollment or authority rules would change

candidate_order: official CosyVoice3 with prior project evidence reviewed
compatibility_gate: Choose only one candidate after measuring available project budget
All weight/tokenizer/download locations remain under approved D-drive directories
Verify an actual incremental-audio serving interface, not only an architecture claim
Do not install FlashInfer into the current native Windows environment; upstream Linux-only support and dependency issue remain a separate feasibility gate
Keep production service and selected voice running
experiments.inputs: Fixed Chinese public sentences including arithmetic results, quantities and units, names, short responses and 30-second long-form speech
acceptance: Content and numeric meaning pass, not merely a low first packet
Original speaker reference retained; human voice acceptance required before any production replacement
Public latency claims not used as local results
No unloading or killing other models to pass memory tests
stop_if: late request can resume after cancel
